Messages.Author: David Naseby
Messages.Body:
When a vampire is burnt, and returned with
Possession, does it keep the cards on it (Blood
Doll, skill cards, etc.)?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:


No, but only because all of those cards fell off
when the vampire went to the ash heap, not because
Possession failed to maintain the connection.

--
L. Scott Johnson (vte...@regency.wizards.com)
Official VtES Net.Rep for Wizards of the Coast.

Messages.Author: Erik R Volkert
Messages.Body:
David Naseby (the...@unsw.edu.au) wrote:
:
: When a vampire is burnt, and returned with
: Possession, does it keep the cards on it (Blood
: Doll, skill cards, etc.)?

No, I don't think so. I'm pretty sure that the other cards get
discarded, and for them, that is that. While that may not make sense
story-wise, I think that's the way the rules work.
Apologies if I'm incorrect.
-"Erik"
